credits_spent: free plan, no card; the AI generator ran once
failures: P2: The gallery page shows 12 elements, but only three are rendered 100 px or wider with a title next to them. The brief asked for at least nine photographs.
P3: The gallery links to one page called 'Serienseiten' that holds two series as sections. The brief asked for three series pages of their own, reachable from the gallery.
P7: Images come from the Strikingly CDN as 960x640 and 960x540 crops. No image is linked and no viewer opens on click, so there is no full-resolution view.
P15: Lighthouse mobile performance 73, LCP 4.5 s. The threshold is 90.
P20: The home page has no H1 at all and 1 of 28 images carries alt text. On the gallery page 4 of 12 do.
notes: Strikingly generated the site from a title plus a free-text description field, not from a paste of the full brief: the 1,100-character prompt from data/app-runs/portfolio.txt does not fit the field, so a five-line version went in. Before the generator runs, the account has to confirm its email address with a code; that is a step no other tool in our set asks for. The result is in German although the brief described English content — the generator ignored the language line. Pages are numbered (/1 to /4), so the navigation carries no readable slugs.
